senses.gloss: (= סחתת, Saf. of חתת), Pi. סִיתֵּת to chip, chisel; to polish.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 12:1">Sabb. XII, 1</cite> <he>המְסַתֵּת</he> he who chisels (on the Sabbath).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 93b:2-5">B. Kam. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>גזל … אבנים וסִיתְּתָן</he> if one stole rough stones and chiselled them. Pesik. ʻĂniya, p. 137ᵇ <he>מְסַתְּתִין בו וכ׳</he> chiselling it, shaping it, carving it (v. <cite ref="O01526"><he>סָרַג</he></cite>). Ib. Shub., p. 165ᵃ <he>סַתְּתוּ קימעה וכ׳</he> chip off little by little &c.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 6:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. VI</cite> <he>היה מסתת והולך וכ׳</he> he went on chipping, until he came to a big rock; a. fr.
